arguments.subject: Executive Incident Update & Remediation: Strict JSON schema enforcement broke /v2/data-sync payloads
arguments.body:
Dear Customer Partner,

Our engineering and incident response teams have completed root-cause analysis: A recent code change (GitHub PR #882) introduced strict Pydantic v2 schema validation for the /v2/data-sync API payloads. The new validation rejects legacy metadata fields that existing production ETL jobs still send, causing the service to raise 500 errors. Multiple alerts (Datadog), a Jira ticket (PROD-1042) reporting intermittent 500s, and a critical email from the Acme champion all point to the same endpoint failure after the Thursday deployment. The root cause originates in the backend code change managed via GitHub, making the GitHub subsystem the primary culprit..
Remediation actions are underway and service stability is being actively restored.

Incident Commander | Enterprise Support
